Choose the layout that feels right.
A · Familiar sidebar and a calm overview.
B · Top navigation and one open page.
C · A weekly schedule with details beside it.
Each includes settings, editors, system tools,
loading, errors, cancellation and a narrow view.
Start with A for the closest match to the phone.
